svg.title: What a Cached Prefix Saves
svg.desc: A cost worksheet comparing 10,000 requests with and without a cached 2,000-token prefix, showing the saving once the stable prefix comes first.
svg.text: Cobalt Insights: 10,000 requests, one 2,000-token prefix, Sonnet 5.5 rates.
Tools and system prefix first, changing user text after it; an edit inside the prefix misses the cache
